column1: Knowledge
The demo as-of date is 2026-09-30 and OpenInvoice data spans invoice dates from 2022-01-01 to 2026-09-30.

Pecos Ridge Energy uses Enverus OpenInvoice as the e-invoicing front end for its supply-chain managed categories: chemicals and sand/proppant and tubulars/OCTG and rental equipment and trucking/water hauling. Other categories such as drilling contractors and pressure pumping are not in OpenInvoice.
OpenInvoice went live on 2022-01-01. Field tickets are approved in the field and invoices route through Coupa (COUPA_DOC_ID) and post to SAP.

Since the January 2025 integration upgrade the spend-analytics invoice id is stamped back onto the OpenInvoice header as OI_INVOICE.ERP_INVOICE_ID which equals PECOS_RIDGE_PROCUREMENT_SCM.SCM.SPEND_INVOICE.INVOICE_ID. Invoices dated before 2025-01-01 have a NULL ERP_INVOICE_ID and ERP_MATCH_STATUS = 'Legacy - Coupa id only'.
For stamped invoices OI_INVOICE.INVOICE_TOTAL_USD equals SPEND_INVOICE.AMOUNT_USD to the cent and the lines on OI_INVOICE_LINE sum to the invoice total.
To join OpenInvoice to spend analytics use OI_INVOICE.ERP_INVOICE_ID = SPEND_INVOICE.INVOICE_ID; before 2025 join on LIFNR and the invoice date and amount instead.

The supplier key everywhere is LIFNR: the 10-character SAP vendor number with leading zeros (for example 0000100039). It joins OI_SUPPLIER and OI_INVOICE and OI_INVOICE_LINE to S4_VENDOR_LFA1 and SPEND_INVOICE.

SUPPLIER_NAME_AS_SUBMITTED on OI_INVOICE varies in case and suffix from invoice to invoice (Basin Chemical and BASIN CHEMICAL LLC and Basin Chemical Svcs are the same vendor); group suppliers by LIFNR or by OI_SUPPLIER.SUPPLIER_NAME and never by the submitted name.

The generic product is NOT a column on OI_INVOICE_LINE. The line carries only the supplier's marketing description (SUPPLIER_ITEM_DESCRIPTION) and code; the generic product comes from SCM_ITEM_CLASSIFICATION joined on LIFNR and SUPPLIER_ITEM_CODE and then SCM_PRODUCT_TAXONOMY. Use V_INVOICE_LINE_CLASSIFIED which does this join.

A generic product is a supplier-neutral name for what was bought: for example Corrosion inhibitor water-soluble filming amine. CorroShield CS-7000 from Corrosion Control Chem and CorroGuard BC-220 from Basin Chemical are both that generic product.

Only classification rows with REVIEW_STATUS = 'Approved' count as classified. Needs review (an ML suggestion below the 0.70 auto-approve threshold) and Unclassified rows leave the line in the steward queue (V_UNCLASSIFIED_SPEND) where GENERIC_PRODUCT_NAME shows as 'Unclassified'.

The classification backlog is recent: new supplier items appear faster than the steward classifies them so the unclassified share of 2026 line spend is higher than in 2025 and sits mostly in rental equipment and distributor items with vague descriptions such as MISC SUPPLIES or RENTAL EQUIP PER TICKET.

Standard unit price means line spend divided by standard quantity where standard quantity is QUANTITY times CONVERSION_FACTOR_TO_STD_UOM. A 55 gal drum converts to 55 gallons; a 330 gal tote to 330; a 5 gal pail to 5; a casing joint to 42 feet; a tubing joint to 31 feet; a monthly rental to 30 days; a weekly rental to 7 days.

Compare prices between suppliers only in the standard UOM of the generic product (GAL for chemicals; TON for proppant; FT for casing and tubing; DAY for rentals; BBL for water hauling and disposal; HR for trucks and technicians). Never compare per-drum with per-tote or per-joint with per-foot prices.
Small packs carry a premium: pails and drums cost more per gallon than totes and bulk deliveries of the same chemical. The pack is visible in INVOICED_UOM and in the description.

Price dispersion for a generic product and year is the highest supplier average standard unit price divided by the lowest minus one. Savings at best observed price is the volume of each supplier times the gap between its average price and the lowest supplier average price that year (V_SUPPLIER_ALTERNATIVES).
V_SUPPLIER_ALTERNATIVES only includes generic products flagged ALTERNATE_SUPPLIER_ELIGIBLE and excludes the Fees & surcharges family.

Fees and surcharges (fuel surcharge and delivery charge and environmental fee and standby time and minimum charge) are separate invoice lines in the Fees & surcharges family. They are excluded from unit-price and price-dispersion views and summarised on OI_INVOICE.SURCHARGES_USD.

A price book is a supplier's contract rate schedule loaded in OpenInvoice (OI_PRICEBOOK_ITEM) keyed by supplier item code and version; only the two chemical suppliers and the three sand suppliers and the five water haulers have price books. Lines are matched to the rate in force on the invoice date and PRICE_VARIANCE_USD = (unit price minus contract rate) times quantity.

A line invoiced more than 2 percent above its contract rate is normally Disputed with DISPUTE_REASON 'Unit price above contract rate' and the invoice status becomes Disputed; some are Short-paid instead.

From February 2026 Redline Sand invoiced its RL100 100-mesh sand about 8.5 percent above the RLS-2026 price book rate and most of those lines are disputed. Kermit Sand and Monahans Proppant invoice within their price books.

Monahans Proppant prices sand FOB the mine and bills last-mile trucking as a separate line (generic product Proppant last-mile logistics) while Kermit Sand and Redline Sand quote delivered-to-pad prices; a fair proppant comparison adds Monahans' last-mile line to its sand price.

Five-and-a-half inch 20 pound P-110 BTC production casing is described six different ways across distributors and billed per joint (42 feet) or per foot. The taxonomy maps every variant to the generic product Production casing 5-1/2 in 20 lb/ft P-110 BTC with standard UOM FT.

OI_INVOICE_LINE.AFE_NUMBER is populated for capital invoices (SOURCE_LEDGER 'AFE actual (capex)') and PROPERTY_NUMBER for lease operating invoices (SOURCE_LEDGER 'LOE (lease operating statement)'); the well on an invoice is derived from the AFE through OD_AFE_HEADER or from the property through ZFI_SYSTEM_XWALK.

To get cost per lateral foot join V_AFE_PRODUCT_COST to PECOS_RIDGE_CORP_MDM.MASTER.WELL_MASTER on CORP_WELL_ID and divide spend by LATERAL_LENGTH_FT; restrict to horizontal wells with LATERAL_LENGTH_FT greater than zero.
V_AFE_PRODUCT_COST joins to PECOS_RIDGE_DRILLING_WELLVIEW.WV.WVJOB on AFE_NUMBER to put OpenInvoice product spend next to WellView drilling and completion jobs.
The AFE number format is STYY-NNNNNT where the trailing letter is D for drilling and C for completion and F for facilities; it joins to PECOS_RIDGE_REV_ACCOUNTING.QUORUM_FIN.OD_AFE_HEADER.AFE_NUMBER.
Price books reference the Icertis contract in PECOS_RIDGE_PROCUREMENT_SCM.SCM.CLM_CONTRACT through CLM_CONTRACT_ID (Chemical Supply Agreement and Proppant Supply Agreement and Water Hauling MSA).

OI_SUPPLIER_CATEGORY and OI_COST_CODE are the accounting view (same vocabulary as SPEND_INVOICE.SPEND_CATEGORY and COST_CATEGORY) and are too coarse for product analysis; LEVEL1_FAMILY and GENERIC_PRODUCT_NAME are the supply chain view.
Cost codes: LOE-CHEM chemicals; CAP-PROP proppant; CAP-OCTG casing and tubulars; CAP-RENT rental equipment; LOE-SWD water hauling and disposal; CAP-WTR frac water sourcing and transfer.
Business units map to basins: Midland Basin is Midland; Delaware Basin is Delaware; Midcon is Anadarko; Hugoton is Hugoton.

Every invoice line for a delivery or a service or a rental references a field ticket (OI_FIELD_TICKET) approved by a company man; PO-backed casing and some PO proppant deliveries have no field ticket.

Jessica Whitaker is the category manager for chemicals and water logistics; Clint Johnson owns proppant and OCTG; Hector Brown owns rental equipment and fees and MRO and is the data steward who classifies items.
Supplier spec sheets and MSA Exhibit B pricing schedules live in the supplier document archive; SCM_ITEM_CLASSIFICATION.SOURCE_DOCUMENT and OI_PRICEBOOK_ITEM.SOURCE_DOCUMENT hold the file names.
The 2025 benchmark price per standard UOM on SCM_PRODUCT_TAXONOMY is supply chain's reference from the category reviews; it is not a contract rate.

Questions about price per gallon or per ton or per foot by supplier should use V_GENERIC_PRODUCT_PRICE_MONTHLY or V_SUPPLIER_ALTERNATIVES; questions about contract compliance use V_PRICEBOOK_VARIANCE; questions about the backlog use V_UNCLASSIFIED_SPEND.
When a question says corrosion inhibitor without qualification assume the water-soluble filming amine product (SCM-01-01-001) which is the hero of the chemicals category review.
Years in this domain are invoice years (INVOICE_YEAR on the views is derived from OI_INVOICE.INVOICE_DATE); 2026 is a partial year through September.

OpenInvoice keeps synced copies of the cost objects it validates invoices against: OI_REF_WELL (from WELL_MASTER) and OI_REF_AFE (from OD_AFE_HEADER) and OI_REF_VENDOR (from S4_VENDOR_LFA1) refreshed nightly; use them to join OpenInvoice lines to wells and AFEs and vendors inside this database. The golden records stay in the MDM and Quorum and SAP databases.

OI_ERP_INTEGRATION_LOG holds one row per stamped invoice with the amount and coding the ERP recorded (the spend analytics view); join it to OI_INVOICE on ERP_INVOICE_ID to reconcile OpenInvoice totals to what posted.

The OpenInvoice database is served by its own Snowflake connection; a single SQL query cannot join its tables directly to tables on the other Pecos Ridge connections. For well or AFE or vendor attributes use the OI_REF_* synced copies.
Cost per lateral foot: join V_AFE_PRODUCT_COST to OI_REF_WELL on CORP_WELL_ID and divide spend by LATERAL_LENGTH_FT for wells with a lateral length greater than zero.
